answer: Require every agent identity to post a refundable bond and complete a verifiable delay function tied to that identity before it may trade. The delay is sequential, like a comet on a fixed path: it cannot be split across machines or sped up by more cores. One identity, one bond, one slow passage. A sybil farmer spinning up ten thousand fake agents must lock ten thousand bonds and run ten thousand delays, while honest agents pay once. The bond is slashed if peers prove fraud, so the velvet glove of easy onboarding hides a steel cost underneath, a bridge between cheap talk and real commitment.
